Commentary.Commentary: Time to draw the curtain on this action-packed game. The final is on Sunday. Unfortunately, the home team won't play a part in it but India vs Bangladesh also promises to be a cracking game. Do join us at 1330 GMT (1900 local) for all the action. Cheers!

Shakib Al Hasan, the winning skipper, says that the match was filled with a lot of drama. Feels that they were lucky to win the game and credits Sri Lanka for their recovery. On his batting, he says that he just wanted to give Mahmudullah the strike and is all praise for him for the way he played in the last five overs. On the argument, he says that his emotions got the better of him as there was excitement and also confusion. Adds that the Sri Lankans are their good friends off the pitch. Ends by saying that he is looking forward for the final as they have the momentum but is aware of the fact that India are a very good team.

Thisara Perera, the Sri Lankan skipper, states that the whole team is disappointed but thanks the crowd for the support. On the target, he feels that they were 10-15 runs short. Ends by saying that he is happy for the youngsters as they are looking promising.

Man of the Match, Mahmudullah, says that he rates this as one of his best innings. He adds that a win was needed for them and with Shakib back in the squad it boosted their confidence. On his batting, he answers that his plan was to watch the ball well and hit it hard. He continues and says that he got nervous when Rahim got out but got confidence from his partners. On the last over scenes, he replies that this happens sometimes and it all is a part of the game.

Tamim Iqbal is down with Russel Arnold for a chat. He says that they all are very emotional after the win. On being asked about the argument, he replies that their players were only confused about the no-ball decision not given by the umpire. Adds that the Sri Lankans are their good friends and this won't cause a rift between them. About the finish, he feels that Mahmudullah kept his cool and is out of words to describe the end. On his knock, he states that he should have stayed longer and finished the game as he was set. Ends by saying that it was a good team effort and the plans were well executed.

In spite of losing Liton Das early, Bangladesh kept themselves on track by maintaining a good rate. The partnership between Tamim and Shakib was very crucial in the context of the game. Sri Lanka did manage to take this game close by picking wickets and bowling tidily. Jeevan Mendis, Amila Aponso and Danushka Gunathilaka left their mark but the other bowlers failed to hold their composure towards the end. They dearly missed the service of Nuwan Pradeep who hurt his hamstring and didn't bowl a single over. Mahmudullah was the real star, playing a stunning knock and showed his class. Tension, pressure, nerves, emotions - Mahmudullah controlled all and hit 12 runs off three balls after the ugly onfield incident to steer his team in the final.

It was a great game of Twenty20! Sri Lanka started on a false note by losing the cream of their batting inside the Powerplay. Kusal Perera and Thisara Perera then joined forces to start the revival and courtesy their 97-run stand, Sri Lanka managed to claw back. Some late hitting by Thisara powered them to a total which many considered to be challenging, if not winning.

What a thrilling game! Pressure and tension mounted towards the end and have to say, a calm and composed Mahmudullah did an outstanding job to see his side through to the final. Thisara Perera experiences his 8th loss as a captain, an unwanted 100 percent losing record. The home side will be deeply disappointed. They won't be in the final of a tri-series which is organized to celebrate their 70th year of independence.

SIX! OUT OF HERE! MAHMUDULLAH HAS DONE IT! BANGLADESH ARE IN THE FINAL! Pin-drop silence in the stadium. The only noise you will hear is of a bunch of Bangladeshi boys all pumped up. Udana delivers it full and on the leg stump, Mahmudullah picks it off his pads and dismisses it over deep square leg for a maximum. Boy, terrific scenes out there, the whole of the Bangladesh dressing room is out there, jumping and hugging each other. Aahhh...here comes the cobra dance now. These lads are all charged up. Oh, hang on, some altercation again between the players from both sides. Courtney Walsh, the coach with his specs on, is trying to control his players, looking a bit like a school teacher. Calm down guys, it's just a game of cricket.

Nearly a run out! Fuller and on middle, Mahmudullah clips it through square leg and returns for the risky second run. The keeper gathers the ball and tries to deflect it onto the stumps. Misses it and Mahmudullah makes it safely. Could have been touch and go.
FOUR! Mahmudullah, you beauty! All the pressure and tension and he has played an outstanding shot. Latches onto a fuller length ball outside off and powers it over covers for a boundary.

The word we are getting is that the square leg umpire called the last ball a no ball initially for the second bouncer but then changed his decision (since he didn't signal one for the over after the first ball) which got a few Bangladeshi players worked up. It all led to the incident mentioned below. Anyway, it seems that sanity has prevailed now. Mahmudullah is still on the field. Shakib climbs the stairs and goes in the dressing room. He is very angry. Good part is that we will continue with this match.

Rubel Hossain is the new batsman. Things heating up there as Tharanga pushed one of the Bangladesh substitute players who was out there serving water to Mahmudullah. It has not gone down well with Shakib Al Hasan who is fuming at the boundary line. Wait, he is calling back his batsmen! The match officials are now getting involved but Shakib ain't agreeing. He wants his batsmen off the ground. Not looking good.

OUT! Rahman is run out! Another shorter length ball around off, Mustafizur tries to pull but misses. This time Mahmudullah wants to steal a bye and calls his partner. The keeper parries it to the bowler who breaks the stumps. It's referred upstairs and the replays find Rahman short.
A run out appeal this time is referred upstairs. It's all happening out there. Sri Lanka are looking very confident.

Safe! Nothing in the replays. Udana digs in a short ball around middle and leg, Rahman tries to hook but misses. They appeal but nothing from the umpire. Sri Lanka want to opt for the DRS. The replays come but it finds nothing.
DRS time! Appeal for a caught behind. Not given and it's referred by Sri Lanka.
12 needed off 6 balls. Mustafizur Rahman has joined Mahmudullah in the middle and he will be on strike. Who is bowling this pressure over? It's Isuru Udana.

OUT! Hasan has to depart! He drives a full ball to mid off and scampers across to the other end. Shanaka picks up the ball and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. The umpire goes upstairs and the replays show that Hasan is short of the crease. Another wicket falls and the worst part for Bangladesh is that Mahmudullah won't be on strike for the next over.
Direct hit at the non-striker's end! Mehidy looks to be in trouble. Is he run out? Let's find out...

Well fielded, Kusal Mendis! Saves a run for his side. Every run matters in a close run chase. A full length ball outside off, Mahmudullah hangs back and hammers it through cover-point. Kusal Mendis in the deep runs across to his left, puts in a valiant dive and pulls the ball back just before the rope. The umpire gets it checked upstairs and it's a clean one.

FOUR! Cheeky by Mahmudullah! Perera delivers a fuller length ball outside off, Mahmudullah shuffles across the stumps and neatly spoons it over short fine leg for a boundary. Vital, very vital boundary for Bangladesh!

Misses the yorker mark, a low full toss on off, Mahmudullah swings it in front of square leg and takes a single. Pressurizes the fielder there by looking for the second and the fielder misfields. Two runs added to the total. 19 off 9!
Excellent delivery this time. Too full and around off, once again a little shimmy by Mahmudullah as he tries to hit it through the line. Fails to make any connection.

Lucky to get away with this, Perera. A full toss around off, Mahmudullah shimmies down the track looking for a big shot but it takes the inside half of his blade and runs to deep mid-wicket. A couple taken.
Mehidy Hasan is the new batsman. Also a bowling change, skipper Thisara Perera to bowl the penultimate over.

OUT! Shakib holes out and the crowd has gone mad! They certainly know the value of this wicket. Let me tell you, Shakib will feel he is very unlucky to find the only fielder there in the deep. A full ball is on his pads and he  whips it over backward square leg. Akila Dananjaya is placed exactly there and he makes no mistake. 23 needed off 12 balls!
Mishit but safe! Once again Mahmudullah tries forcing a full ball through covers by staying on the back foot. It takes the outside part of the blade and flies over backward point for one.
Fullish and outside off, Mahmudullah keeps his weight on the back leg and drives it through covers for a run.
A low full toss around leg, Shakib sweeps it through backward square leg and the fielder at fine leg does well to make the stop in the deep. Only a single.

Sprays it full and way wide outside off, Mahmudullah reaches out for it and flashes his blade through the line. Connects but not exactly from the middle of the bat and it flies down to third man for a run.
Some change in the field. Mid off drops back and fine leg comes up.
Good delivery, a near yorker around off, Shakib digs it out from the bottom half of his bat to mid-wicket. Collects a single.
Isuru Udana is brought into the attack.
Shakib uses his feet to force a full ball to long off for a run. 11 from the over, 29 needed off 18 balls.
Smart batting. Got a boundary off the previous ball and this time just nudges it in the gap at mid-wicket to rotate the strike. This is the experienced pair in the middle for Bangladesh.

SIX! Stunned silence in the stands. That's a clinical shot by Mahmudullah. He skips down the track to reach a fuller length ball and admonishes it over the bowler's head for a maximum. Clean as a whistle.
This one is dragged down and Mahmudullah eases it behind square leg for a couple of runs.
Left alone, interesting. A nicely flighted ball around off, spinning away, Mahmudullah watches it go without playing any shot.
Flighted full ball around off, lofted over the bowler's head and it went on one bounce to the long off fielder. A single taken. 39 needed off 23 balls!
Inside out shot from Mahmudullah. Lofts this over covers and comes back for two.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.
Short ball, Mahmudullah taps it through mid-wicket and they cross.
FOUR! Great drive. Gunathilaka darts this outside off, Mahmudullah fetches for it and drives it superbly through covers for a boundary.
Shakib punches this towards mid on and gets one.
Wide! The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Outside off, Shakib fails to put bat on ball.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
Shakib Al Hasan arrives to a big ovation.

OUT! Bangladesh are losing wickets at quick intervals now. After Rahim fell they have lost two more post that. Not helping their own cause. Tossed up delivery, the ball holds up and the spins away from Sarkar. He comes down the track and plays at the wrong line and gets an outside edge to it. Kusal takes the catch after fumbling and even takes the bails off as he is not sure of the edge. Sarkar comes back inside but the umpire raises his finger for caught behind.
Sarkar opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man.
Sarkar whips this towards square leg for another two.
Sarkar leans forward and pushes this in the gap through covers for a brace.
Sarkar has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Mahmudullah walks in next. 55 needed off 36 balls. Jeevan Mendis is brought back into the attack as well.

OUT! Great, great catch by Kusal Perera. Another superb effort behind the wickets. Gunathilaka serves a flighted full ball around off, spinning away a bit, Tamim advances down the track for a lofted shot over covers but fails to middle it properly. Takes a fine edge and hurries to the keeper. He fails to grab it first as the ball hits him on the left shoulder and pops in front of him. He, then, tries to catch but it once again bounces off his gloves this time, hits him on the grille of the helmet before settling down in his mitts. He doesn't bother to go for stumping, straightaway jumps in appeal and the finger has gone up as well. Massive setback to Bangladesh and the crowd in Colombo is going bonkers. What an atmosphere!
Walks down the track and pushes a full ball to long off for a run.
Fifty for Tamim Iqbal, his 5th in T20Is! Flighted ball outside off, Iqbal drills it through covers for a single. A vital knock by the southpaw but he needs to carry on.
Quicker one on middle, worked on the leg side for one.
Flatter ball outside off, fuller in length, Sarkar forces it through covers and collects a brace.
Gets back to a shortish ball and punches it on the off side, straight to the cover fielder.
Sarkar drives this through covers for one.
Driven through the covers by Tamim. One run added to the total.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Soumya Sarkar walks in next as it continues to spit.

OUT! Commentator's curse? Just as we were praising the way Bangladesh were going about their chase they lose a wicket. And it's of the man in red hot form. Mushfiqur Rahim.  Aponso gives this air, Rahim charges down and looks to go over covers but hits it straight to Thisara stationed there. He hit it well and the ball was traveling, a very good catch by Perera who times his jump to perfection. Aponso does the snake dance while giving Rahim a send-off.
Tamim hits this towards mid on and gets one more. They are doing it well till now.
Rahim pushes this through mid off to get another run.
Amila Aponso comes in for another spell.
SIX! Great short. Loopy ball, outside off, Tamim charges down and lofts it over mid off for a biggie.
Tamim dabs this towards square leg and gets couple for it.
Wide. Almost a clever stumping. Akila sees Tamim coming down and darts this outside off. Tamim gets back inside but it's a clear wide.
Three dot balls in a row now. Tamim drives it towards covers and a good stop there saves a run for his team.
Tamim has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tamim dances down the track but decides to defend it.
Rahim eases this through mid-wicket for another run.
Akila Dananjaya comes back into the attack. It has started to drizzle a bit as I type.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Fifty partnership for these two. Tamim strokes his towards mid-wicket for one more.
Outside off, Tamim is late trying to work it to third man and the ball just misses his outside edge.

Rahim plays this towards mid-wicket and rotates strike. This single brings up 1000 T20I runs for him. He is going through a purple patch at the moment and Bangladesh would love his presence till the end of this run-chase.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Short ball, Rahim punches this towards mid on for a run.
Rahim opens the face of the bat and guides it to third man for one. Bangladesh are 80-2 after 10 overs.
Short ball, Tamim pulls this in front of square for a run.
Tamim delicately works it fine down the leg side.
Rahim plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Cut and cut hard. Outside off, Rahim cuts it over the backward point fielder for a boundary.
Back of a length ball, Tamim punches this off his back foot on the off side for one.
Another change. Isuru Udana is the seventh bowler to bowl now.
Pitched up, Tamim pushes it towards mid off for a run to end the over. Just three of it.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.

Run out chance goes begging. Tamim drives this towards mid off and quickly moves to the other end. The fielder there collects it and has a shy at the stumps on the non-striker's end. Had he hit, Tamim was well short, even if Mendis had collected that, Tamim would have been a goner.
Straight in line of the stumps, Tamim gets behind it and blocks it.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Full ball, Tamim hits it back to the bowler.
Jeevan Mendis to bowl now.
Rahim drives this to mid off for a dot.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
SIX! Tossed up and Tamim charges down and plays an inside-out shot high over covers for half a dozen.
Bangladesh are switching ends well. Another run through mid-wicket.
Full again, Tamim drives this through mid off to rotate strike.
Floated ball, Rahim plays this through mid-wicket for one more.
Change of ends for Akila Dananjaya.
Rahim helps this towards mid-wicket to retain strike.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Great piece of fielding from Gunathilaka. Bowls this full on middle, Tamim hits it to the bowler's right who dives to stop the runs.
Five Wides! Poor bowling from Gunathilaka! Strays this down the leg again. This time way too far for anyone to make contact. Darts this down and the ball races away to the fine leg boundary.
Wide. The batsman tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side. Wide signalled by the umpire.
On the pads of Tamim, who misses his flick and the ball hits him on the pads.
Outside off, Tamim guides it to the short third man fielder.
Tossed up, Rahim goes for the flick but gets a leading edge towards covers for one.
Danushka Gunathilaka to roll his arm now.

FOUR! Quality shot! Width on offer outside off, a bit on the shorter side, Tamim eases himself on the back foot and carves it through backward point for a boundary. 50/2 in the Powerplay, a decent beginning by Bangladesh.
The batsman guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Almost an lbw, had he missed! A length ball around off, Rahim gets across the stumps and flicks it in front of square leg for a couple of runs.
Angling away from the batsman, on a length, Tamim stays back and dabs it down to third man for one.
Keeps it full and around off, Tamim strides forward in defense.
Fuller and straighter, Rahim helps it through mid-wicket and collects a run.
Thisara Perera to bowl now...
Bat on ball this time as Rahim tickles it in the gap at mid-wicket for a run.
Stifled appeal for an lbw! Quicker delivery, on middle and leg, Rahim fails to work it around and is hit on the pads. The bowler lets out a muted appeal knowing that would have missed the leg stump.
Rahim has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Fine shot! Tossed up ball around off, Rahim makes room, advances down the track and clobbers it over mid off for a cracking boundary.
Gets forward and flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Flatter and outside off, played down to point.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
The batsman going through a purple patch, Mushfiqur Rahim arrives in the middle.

OUT! Stumped and it's of the highest quality, I will tell you why... A well tossed up off spinner landing around off, Sabbir jumps out of the crease to flick but misses and the ball spins back in to hit him on the pads. Then it goes behind and in spite of the deflection and also being blindsighted for a moment, Kusal Perera manages to gather the ball and break the stumps. It's an excellent piece of stumping. On closer look in the replays, Kusal there didn't gather the ball cleanly but still managed to do the job. Hmm...still commendable given all that happened before the ball arrived to him. Sabbir's knock was good till it lasted. 127 needed off 97 balls!
Knocks a full ball down the ground but finds the mid on fielder.

FOUR! The move to send Sabbir at number 3 has worked so far. He brings out the reverse sweep and unfurls a nicely timed shot. Amila Aponso dives all over it at short third man and concedes a boundary. That's a dot ball which has gone for a four. Not what the Lankans want.
Quickish and full on off, Tamim leans forward to defend but it takes the inner half of the bat and rolls in front of square leg. A single is taken.
Turning into the batsman from around middle, on the shorter side, Tamim uses the depth of his crease and works it to the right of the fielder in the deep mid-wicket region. A couple taken.
Aponso doesn't believe in flighting. Arrows another one in, around off, Rahman leans forward, brings his bat in front of the pads and blocks.
Fires this one in, full and on middle, Tamim helps it through mid-wicket for a run.

Oh dear, this is not looking good. Nuwan Pradeep has not moved after going down and is clutching his hamstring. He is leaving the field and is not at all moving freely. Big blow to Sri Lanka if he ain't coming back to participate in this match.

FOUR! Deft from Tamim. He fetches a length ball from around leg and nudges it past short fine leg. Nuwan Pradeep tries chasing it from inside the ring but in the process has pulled his hamstring. He is down on ground as the ball speeds past the rope.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Rahman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Quicker one, full and on middle, 96 kph, it's tucked through mid-wicket for a run.
Amila Aponso is into the attack now.

FOUR! Sabbir has come out with a positive intent. Dananjaya drags his length short and bowls it wide outside off. Sabbir rocks back and punches it superbly through covers. 9 runs and a wicket from it!
FOUR! Nicely timed and placed. Flighted and full around middle and leg, Rahman kneels and sweeps it all along the ground through backward square leg. Sweet timing and it's a boundary.
Sabbir Rahman has been promoted up the order. Interesting move. They have tried him before in this position but without much success. Can he do it in this crunch game?

OUT! Akila draws first blood! He serves a flighted full ball outside off, Das spots the mid off fielder inside the ring and tries to go over him. Fails to get proper connection and lofts it straight into the hands of Thisara Perera. He is not dropping those. Litton is disappointed. He should have done better there as the idea was right and there was enough width on offer too.
Tossed up ball on middle, Das plays the sweep shot but finds the short fine leg fielder.
Aerial but safe! Flatter and outside off, Tamim hammers it through the line, doesn't bother to keep it down and it whizzes to the deep. There is a fielder at long off and they cross.
Flighted full ball on middle and off, Tamim defends it by drawing forward.
Akila Dananjaya to bowl from the other end. A slip in place.

Beaten! What a delivery! Out of nowhere. Has been poor all over and now produces a gem. Gets extra lift from a good length outside off, straightening off the seam, Das has a tame push inside the line and misses. 10 from the first over, a good foundation for Bangladesh.
Wide! Poor over from Pradeep, this. Slides a full ball down the leg side, Liton tries flicking but misses.
Clips a full ball off his pads but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Pradeep keeps his line straight and drops it on a length, Tamim unfurls a beautiful straight drive past the bowler. The mid on fielder has no chance.

Slowness off the pitch is quite evident on this delivery. It's on a length outside off, Tamim is a bit early into the shot as he tries to punch it through covers. Gets a bottom edge as it rolls to mid-wicket.
FOUR! This time he goes the aerial route. Latches onto a fuller length ball outside off and slices it over backward point. Not from the middle of the bat but it still races through to the fence.
Short in length outside off, Tamim cracks it square of the wicket on the off side but finds the point fielder.
Back for the chase! Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das are the openers for Bangladesh. 160 in 120 legal balls, that's the target to reach the final. Nuwan Pradeep to begin proceedings. Here we go...
